body.name: Downward-closed coupled chart cover
body.construction:
Write \(F\preceq G\) when \(F\) is the loopless spanning subgraph on \(V\) with \(E(F)\subseteq E(G)\). Define \(\operatorname{Cover}^{\le}_{\mathcal I}(G,H)\) to hold exactly when, for every \(F\preceq G\) and every \(C\in\mathcal D_F\), there exist a spanning subgraph \(K\preceq H\), a matrix \(D\in\mathcal D_K\), a surjection \(f:U_C\twoheadrightarrow U_D\), and nonzero scalars \((a_i)_{i\in U_C}\) such that
\[
C_{:,i}=a_iD_{:,f(i)}\quad(i\in U_C),
\qquad
T_S(C)=T_S(D)\quad(S\in\mathcal I).
\]
All quantifiers over \(F\), \(K\), visible subsets, and surjection types range over finite sets determined by \((N,G,H)\).
